{{Top|leg}}
The '''Imperial Center Guard''' was an organization that existed by [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]]. [[Swart Swifto]] served as a trainer for the [[Grand Army of the Republic]] and later for the Imperial Center Guard. In [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], the Imperial Center Guard was mentioned in an interview with Swifto by [[Eschul Shaywa]] of ''[[Imperial Center Today]]''<ref name="Author's Cut">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-2-ancient-coruscant|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 2 - Ancient Coruscant}}</ref>
